quiz.q: According to Lucian Pye's framework, why is India characterized as a 'soft state'?
options: It has high political participation and differentiation but lacks the state capacity to enforce laws.
It has strong legal enforcement mechanisms but lacks structural differentiation and citizen participation.
Its rapid economic industrialization has progressed without creating specialized institutions for governance.
Its citizens display complete indifference to the political system like a parochial political culture.
quiz.why: India demonstrates high political participation and functional differentiation, but struggles with state capacity to enforce laws firmly.

quiz.q: According to Samuel Huntington, political decay occurs primarily when which condition arises?
options: Citizens lose interest in politics and retreat into a traditional parochial culture.
Political participation grows much faster than institutions can develop adaptability and coherence.
Economic modernization fails to introduce industrialization, secularization, and urban growth.
State capacity expands excessively to suppress popular voting rights and civic mobilization.
quiz.why: Huntington argued that political decay occurs when mass participation expands faster than the institutional capacity to absorb it.

quiz.q: In Almond and Verba's typology, how does a subject political culture differ from a participant culture?
options: Subjects remain totally unaware of the system, whereas participants passively obey state laws.
Subjects focus on governmental policy outputs, whereas participants actively engage in political inputs.
Subjects participate actively through regular elections, whereas participants reject democratic institutions.
Subjects demand rapid modernization, whereas participants prefer traditional tribal forms of governance.
quiz.why: In a subject culture, citizens feel affected by policy outputs but do not participate in shaping political inputs.

quiz.q: Why do Almond and Verba argue that a pure participant culture can endanger democratic stability?
options: It deprives the state of functional differentiation and specialized administrative bodies.
It leads to complete citizen indifference and weakens overall political consciousness.
It creates excessive passions and uncontrolled demands that demagogues can exploit.
It prevents the society from adopting industrialization, secularization, and economic modernization.
quiz.why: Unchecked participation without balancing subject and parochial orientations can generate extreme passions that demagogues exploit to subvert democracy.
